Behavior: Enumerates file-backed project stores, parses their tool version and checks tool/schema compatibility for ETS6. Logs and displays an error listing incompatible stores, returning false if any exist; otherwise returns true.
Scope: One class in two physical ETS executables; not an ETS6N-wide naming pass.
InitialBuildAttempt: Direct x86 builds failed resolving AnyCPU project references. Used the existing solution configuration for ETS6N and AnyCPU for ETS6N.2. Both then passed.
